history.summary: Freehold 1BR shoebox (527sqft) at a small FH project off Foo Kim Lin Rd (Eunos/Kaki Bukit, near Ubi/Kaki Bukit DT MRT). Asking $1,670 psf sits near the TOP of the project's actual recent shoebox range, not the bargain the algo implies.
history.rating_rationale: The algo flags this as cheap (age_adj_premium -12.5%, score 713), but that rests on a single comparable (psf_cohort_txns=1) and is contradicted by real transactions: the last-12-month range is $1,298-$1,699 psf (avg ~$1,555), with the $1,699 high set by a tiny 441sqft unit. At $1,670 psf this 527sqft unit is asking near the ceiling, so the 'cheapness' is a thin-data quirk, not verified value. Positives are real: freehold, a deep rental record (387 rental txns vs 36 sales since 2016) supporting decent shoebox yield, and District 14 sits in the favorable RCR/OCR forward band. But trailing appreciation is flat (1.37% CAGR over 25 txns, ~0 forward power) with no dated catalyst, and the price gives no margin of safety. Near-fair, not a buy.
